name: Pharez
overview: Pharez, also known as Perez or Phares, is a significant figure in Scripture as the twin son of Judah and Tamar, whose birth is marked by the breaking forth of his hand first, symbolizing a breach or breakthrough (Genesis 38:29). He is the ancestor of important family lines within the tribe of Judah, with his sons Hezron and Hamul continuing his lineage (Genesis 46:12; 1 Chronicles 2:5). The families descending from Pharez are identified as the Pharzites, Hezronites, and Hamulites, highlighting his role in the genealogical structure of Israel (Numbers 26:20-21). His place in the lineage of Judah underscores his importance in the biblical record, especially in connection with the return from captivity and ultimately in the Messianic line leading to Jesus Christ.
